data_fields.name: min_build_ticks
data_fields.donor_constant: item cost times blocksize divided by min build turns (theirs, Empire/ProductionQueue.cpp 107)

data_fields.name: bank_capacity
data_fields.donor_constant: sum of planet stockpile meters (theirs, Empire/ProductionQueue.cpp 581-592)

best_idea: A craft can absorb at most its cost divided by its minimum craft time per tick, with overshoot carried into the next copy, and the server alone decides completion.
decision_why: The per-tick cap and the carry give a crafting-time shape the one-ledger ruling allows, expressed in ticks with per-item data. Adapt, and reject the bank as a second pool, because the one-ledger ruling forbids a parallel balance; a buffer, if wanted, becomes a row in the one ledger.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a 60-cost craft with minimum time 5 takes 12 per tick, finishes on tick 5 with 60 debited in total, and that a two-copy order with 10 percent frontload finishes its first copy on tick 5 and carries 1.49 into the second copy.
